title: Administration password changed
purpose: Confirm completion of the signed-in administrator’s password change.

sections.title: State
paragraphs: Displays Your password was changed. No editable fields or password submission controls are present. Laboratory roles, client ownership, release permissions and MFA are unchanged.

items.label: Log out
items.description: Immediately posts sign-out; this is not an allauth sign-out confirmation.

items.label: Toggle theme
items.description: Changes administration appearance in sync with the application theme.
